policy: Record only the independently reviewed Image Resize row beyond the six-row Creative and Image Design checkpoint; fail closed on receipt drift, duplicate identity, missing native ownership, incomplete export reopen proof, or missing browser evidence.

evidence.workflow: Image Resize loads the maintained English image-resize-studio owner and passed presets, fit/fill/pad/stretch geometry, focal coordinates, no-upscale, format, quality, naming, history, invalid/reset, responsive, theme, keyboard, metadata and no-network parity checks.
evidence.export: English and Swahili 60x40 PNG output was byte-identical; direct PNG, JPG and WebP, all four fit modes, and eight batch files were parser-reopened at their exact 60x40 or 512x512 dimensions.
